profile.description: Quick Service Restaurant chains and cloud kitchens with multiple locations

pain_points.pain: High energy costs across multiple locations
pain_points.quantification: ₹8-15 lakh annual energy waste across 20-30 location chain
pain_points.why_it_matters: Energy is 3-5% of revenue; 30-40% of that is cold chain waste
pain_points.current_solution: Reactive: Replace freezers when they fail, no visibility to optimization
pain_points.why_current_fails: Can't see which locations are inefficient until bill arrives

pain_points.pain: Spoilage incidents from undetected temperature excursions
pain_points.quantification: ₹40-80K per incident (product loss + disposal + replacement + reputation)
pain_points.why_it_matters: 12-18 incidents/year typical for 20-location chain = ₹6-12 lakh annual loss
pain_points.current_solution: Manual temperature logging (hourly or daily spot checks)
pain_points.why_current_fails: Staff miss readings, equipment failure happens between checks

pain_points.quantification: 15-20 hours/month manager time for manual log aggregation
pain_points.why_it_matters: Opportunity cost of manager time + risk of audit findings for gaps
pain_points.current_solution: Manual paper logs, Excel transcription, monthly compilation
pain_points.why_current_fails: Human error, missed readings, time-consuming, hard to audit

pain_points.pain: Inconsistent cold chain performance across locations
pain_points.quantification: 20-50% variance in energy consumption for 'identical' setups
pain_points.why_it_matters: Can't identify best practices or problem locations without data
pain_points.why_current_fails: No objective data, bias toward visible issues only
